description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'CampaignTest' for testing the 'Campaigns' module in SuiteCRM. It includes unit tests for campaign creation, subscription management, relationship handling, data retrieval, and other campaign-related functionalities.

classes.name: CampaignTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the Campaigns module, testing various functionalities such as creation, subscription, relationship handling, and data retrieval in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the current user and configuration defaults.

methods.name: testSubscribeUnsubscribeFromNewsLetterCampaign
methods.description: Tests subscribing and unsubscribing a lead to a newsletter campaign and verifies proper list management.

methods.name: testCampaign
methods.description: Verifies the construction and basic attributes of a Campaign object.

methods.name: testlist_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Tests the parsing of additional sections in the list view for a campaign.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Tests the get_summary_text method with and without the campaign name set.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Validates the creation of export SQL queries with various parameters.

methods.name: testclear_campaign_prospect_list_relationship
methods.description: Tests the clearing of prospect list relationships in campaigns without errors.

methods.name: testmark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Tests marking relationships as deleted without errors.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Ensures the fill_in_additional_list_fields method executes without errors.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Ensures the fill_in_additional_detail_fields method executes without errors.

methods.name: testupdate_currency_id
methods.description: Tests the update_currency_id method executes without errors.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Verifies the data returned by get_list_view_data matches expected values.

methods.name: testbuild_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Tests the building of generic WHERE clauses with and without parameters.

methods.name: testSaveAndMarkDeleted
methods.description: Tests saving a campaign and then marking it as deleted, ensuring it is no longer retrievable.

methods.name: testset_notification_body
methods.description: Verifies the notification email body is set with correct campaign data.

methods.name: testtrack_log_leads
methods.description: Tests retrieval of lead activity log SQL query.

methods.name: testtrack_log_entries
methods.description: Tests retrieval of targeted activity log SQL query with and without parameters.

methods.name: testget_queue_items
methods.description: Verifies the SQL query generated for campaign email queue items matches expectations with and without parameters.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Tests whether the Campaign bean claims to implement specific behaviors like ACL.

methods.name: testcreate_list_count_query
methods.description: Tests the SQL for counting campaign list entries, with and without distinct clauses.

methods.name: testgetDeletedCampaignLogLeadsCount
methods.description: Verifies the method returns a count of deleted campaign log leads, expected to be zero in this test context.
